versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the AI-Assisted Performance Review skill
- Provides a framework for fair evaluation when work is AI-assisted, clarifying what measures human contribution vs. tooling
- Produces actionable review guidance: criteria audit, rewritten performance standards, calibration rules for mixed AI adoption, and conversation scripts for difficult cases
- Outlines required inputs and a step-by-step method for separating human and AI signals in performance evaluation
- Includes anti-patterns and quality checks to ensure fair, evidence-based assessments
